firstFailure.message: Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved

previousReleaseGateFailure.diagnosis: Node22 AbortSignal.timeout is unref; intentionally stalled mock transport and fake core expose no referenced IO handle. The synthetic test exits before the deadline rather than executing a failed assertion. Production Electron and Mihomo remain live through actual IO handles.

reproduction.after: 2 selected request/body cases passed with scoped referenced test handle

previousReleaseGateFailure.resolution: Test-only fixture keepalive; parent creates a new immutable desktop tag/version.
